cases.source: The neighborhood garden committee requests that residents participate in the preparation of the shared garden before the beginning of the spring planting period. Maya coordinates the distribution of seeds from the shed beside the gate, and Omar maintains the list of residents who have requested space for vegetables. Residents choose a bed from that list and write their names beside the beds they choose. Each household brings a pair of gloves, a small shovel, and a bottle of drinking water. The committee provides soil, seeds, and watering cans for the work. Children can help with planting when an adult from their household stays with them. People who need a seat can use the benches beside the shed. Residents who cannot attend the planting day can ask Omar for a later task. The group leaves the central path clear so neighbors can reach the gate. Maya keeps unused seeds in the shed for the summer planting period. Omar posts the work schedule on the gate for residents to read. The committee asks each household to water its own bed and place waste in the bins beside the shed.
cases.instruction: Edit this passage under the supplied policy.
review: Preserve all responsibilities, supplies, accessibility, child supervision, alternatives, storage, scheduling, and maintenance facts. Keep later-task meaning; later may need a recast.
